summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Ford Credit Auto Receivables Two LLC, the depositor, solely to satisfy an undertaking to file unqualified legality and tax opinions in connection with a takedown of asset-backed securities (the Notes) issued by Ford Credit Auto Owner Trust 2026-B. The filing attaches opinions from Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP concerning legality and federal income tax matters. No special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change—is disclosed. The filing reflects a standardized securitization issuance, not an extraordinary corporate event.
